Tab Keeper v2.0.1-kiosk - Deployment Information
==============================================

Extension ID: 4nsinwkb7e5khfdund5hlutwfa
Version: 2.0.1-kiosk
Packaged: 2026-06-24
Kiosk Mode: Enabled (ChromeOS Single App Kiosk)

Files:
- tab-keeper-2.0.1-kiosk.zip (Source package for Chrome Admin Console)
- updates.xml (Auto-update manifest)

ChromeOS Kiosk Setup:
1. Upload tab-keeper-2.0.1-kiosk.zip to Chrome Admin Console
2. Configure Kiosk policies (see ENTERPRISE_DEPLOYMENT.md)
3. Powerwash and re-enroll ChromeOS device
4. Device will boot directly into Tab Keeper
